rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for the visible flames of a fire.

example.english: The flame of the campfire flickered in the dark。

rows.note: Use this for a romantic partner or lover, especially in the sense of an affair.

example.english: He went on a trip with his flame behind his wife's back。

rows.note: Use this for the passion, zeal, enthusiasm, or excitement side of the figurative sense.

example.english: His flame for painting has come back。
